product: Liquefied natural gas from its Louisiana liquefaction and export plants: Calcasieu Pass, Plaquemines and CP2, with over 100 MTPA in production, construction or development (2026-08-11). Named buyers include China Gas, Hanwha Aerospace, Trafigura, TotalEnergies, Vitol, EnBW and Atlantic-SEE.
demand: Volume-led. Q2-2026 revenue rose 48 percent on LNG sold up 42 percent to 466.4 TBtu and cargos up 43 percent to 127 (2026-08-11). Q1-2026 revenue rose 59 percent while volumes sold rose 111 percent, so realised unit price fell (2026-05-12). Price or mix is the swing factor since Q2 EBITDA rose 79 percent.
pricing_power: A collapse in the fixed liquefaction fee and the spread between U.S. feed gas and international LNG. Q1-2026 already showed margin compression from a compressed winter spread and Winter Storm Fern, prompting initial FY26 guidance of 5.2-5.8B dollars (2026-03-02). Each plus or minus 1.00 dollar per MMBtu moves FY26 EBITDA by 180-210 million dollars (2026-08-11).
competition: No close Chinese substitute for U.S. LNG molecules; China is a buyer. The low-cost substitutes are Qatari volumes from the North Field expansion, Russian pipeline and Arctic LNG, and coal in Asia. QatarEnergy holds the nearest cost-competitive alternative; Chinese yards supply modules and equipment rather than competing molecules.
market_strategy: 2026-08-11 CEO Mike Sabel said refinancings translate into more than 100 million dollars of annual cost savings and that the company is focused on moving Plaquemines Phase 1 into commercial operations and progressing FIDs at the CP2 and Plaquemines expansions. On 2026-03-02 he said 2026 exported cargos would grow to over 500.
bull: Q2-2026 revenue 4.58B (+48%) on volumes +42%, FY26 EBITDA guidance raised twice to 8.7-9.1B (2026-08-11), plus 3.0B revolver (2026-09-02) and China Gas 20-year SPA (2026-09-14).
bear: Q2 realised fee 6.45/MMBtu vs 12.50-13.50 assumed for unsold cargoes; only 91% of 2026 cargoes contracted at 5.05; Q1 showed margin compression; Plaquemines Phase 1 COD still pending.
falsifier: Plaquemines Phase 1 COD not achieved by 2026-12-31, or FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA guided below 8.7B dollars, or Q3-2026 realised fixed liquefaction fee far under 12.50 dollars per MMBtu.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 30d: 2026-09-02 VGLNG closed a 3.0 billion dollar 364-day revolver (SEC 8-K); 2026-09-14 China Gas signed a 20-year SPA for 0.5 MTPA from 2030, total 2.5 MTPA (ventureglobal.com); 2026-09-10 Scotiabank raised its target to 16 from 15 (MarketBeat). 90d: 2026-08-11 Q2 revenue 4.58B dollars and Adjusted EBITDA 2.49B dollars, FY26 guidance lifted to 8.7-9.1B from 8.2-8.5B.
web_true_now_not_modelled: Q2-2026 realised weighted-average fixed liquefaction fee was 6.45 dollars per MMBtu (SEC 8-K 2026-07-08), yet FY26 guidance assumes 12.50-13.50 dollars per MMBtu for unsold cargos and only 91 percent of 2026 cargos are contracted at 5.05 (2026-08-11). Guidance is levered to uncontracted spot cargo fees rather than the contracted book.
web_demand_product: Liquefied natural gas from its Louisiana liquefaction and export plants: Calcasieu Pass, Plaquemines and CP2, with over 100 MTPA in production, construction or development (2026-08-11). Named buyers include China Gas, Hanwha Aerospace, Trafigura, TotalEnergies, Vitol, EnBW and Atlantic-SEE.
web_price_volume_mix: Volume-led. Q2-2026 revenue rose 48 percent on LNG sold up 42 percent to 466.4 TBtu and cargos up 43 percent to 127 (2026-08-11). Q1-2026 revenue rose 59 percent while volumes sold rose 111 percent, so realised unit price fell (2026-05-12). Price or mix is the swing factor since Q2 EBITDA rose 79 percent.
web_bottleneck: Company bottleneck: completing Plaquemines Phase 1 commissioning and assurance testing for Q4-2026 COD, plus CP2 construction and feed-gas and power supply, where temporary power was used to offset power-plant delays (2026-08-11, 2026-03-02). The constraint it relieves is global LNG supply security for Asian and European buyers.
web_who_benefits_next: U.S. feed-gas producers and Gulf pipelines; EPC, module yards and Gulf Coast labour; LNG shipping owners; Asian buyers (China Gas, KOGAS, Hanwha) and European utilities (EnBW, TotalEnergies); the Bank of America-led bank syndicate on the 2026-09-02 revolver; Louisiana communities and carbon-capture suppliers.
web_who_loses: Higher-cost or delayed rival LNG projects competing for the same offtake, and sellers of pipeline gas displaced in Asia and Europe. Qatari volumes compete on cost for the same Asian buyers. Buyers who locked fixed liquefaction fees lose if spot LNG prices fall below the fee.
web_margin_collapse_risk: A collapse in the fixed liquefaction fee and the spread between U.S. feed gas and international LNG. Q1-2026 already showed margin compression from a compressed winter spread and Winter Storm Fern, prompting initial FY26 guidance of 5.2-5.8B dollars (2026-03-02). Each plus or minus 1.00 dollar per MMBtu moves FY26 EBITDA by 180-210 million dollars (2026-08-11).
web_low_cost_substitute: No close Chinese substitute for U.S. LNG molecules; China is a buyer. The low-cost substitutes are Qatari volumes from the North Field expansion, Russian pipeline and Arctic LNG, and coal in Asia. QatarEnergy holds the nearest cost-competitive alternative; Chinese yards supply modules and equipment rather than competing molecules.
web_ceo_promised: 2026-08-11 CEO Mike Sabel said refinancings translate into more than 100 million dollars of annual cost savings and that the company is focused on moving Plaquemines Phase 1 into commercial operations and progressing FIDs at the CP2 and Plaquemines expansions. On 2026-03-02 he said 2026 exported cargos would grow to over 500.
web_did_they_deliver: On 2026-03-02 CEO Sabel said 2025 targets were all exceeded: 380 cargos, eight 20-year SPAs and about 40 percent above nameplate at Plaquemines. CP2 Phase II FID with 8.6B dollars of financing landed in Q1-2026, matching the promised first half of 2026 (2026-05-12). FY26 EBITDA guidance was raised twice, to 8.7-9.1B (2026-08-11). Plaquemines Phase 1 COD remains pending.
web_what_would_falsify: Plaquemines Phase 1 COD not achieved by 2026-12-31, or FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA guided below 8.7B dollars, or 2026 cargos below 500, or Q3-2026 realised weighted-average fixed liquefaction fee far under the 12.50-13.50 dollars per MMBtu assumption. Next observable check is Q3-2026 results expected around November 2026.
